result.paraphrase: AMD Radeon Pro WX2100 graphics card with 2GB GDDR5 memory, 64-bit bus, peak engine clock of 1219 MHz, and effective memory speed of 1500 MHz. Delivers 1.25 TFLOPS peak single-precision compute and 48 GB/s memory bandwidth. Includes 2 mini-DisplayPort outputs and 1 DisplayPort 1.4 with HBR3/HDR readiness, plus AMD Eyefinity technology, OpenGL 4.5, 10-bit display support, model 100-506001, and a 3-year limited warranty.
